positive_findings: Missing common category, row, direct branch, DRAM field, charge SRAM macro, and energy SRAM macro are rejected.
Straightforward row numerator mismatch, coverage below 95 percent, malformed 3x10 population, bad weight sum, and missing strata are rejected.
Exact resource lane/port/queue drift, identity/SHA drift, writable leaf, hard link, direct symlink, duplicate key, and NaN are rejected.
Runtime output publication uses O_EXCL and mode 0444; a second publication fails.

false_negatives.finding: PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE is a self-asserted config string. Fresh temporary checkpoint/config/profile/capture/hammer bytes, charge JSON, coverage, SRAM/DRAM counts, and energy rates created by the hammer itself receive PASS_PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE_UNHAMMERED. Hashing a self-created file proves integrity after creation, not provenance or admission.

Fixed numerator equality is checked only after weighted aggregation. Each of the six rows can assign its extra numerator to a different population point; equal weights cancel and the compiler passes even though the same point has different numerators across rows.

One row-specific logic_pj_per_cycle is multiplied by both direct and common cycles. A fabricated B0-high/Ours-low rate table applies unequal energy rates to identical common work and produces 0.9999999999999992 energy reduction without changing any charge.

Population membership, density labels, and weights are grammar-checked but not pinned to an admitted manifest. Invented sequence names, relabeled strata, and a 0.5/remaining-skewed weighting pass after self-forged charge keys are updated.
resolve_spec rejects a symlink leaf but accepts a regular file reached through a symlinked parent directory inside the workspace. Immutable-input ancestry is therefore incomplete.

All memory fields and 17 macro names can be present while every SRAM and DRAM access is self-reported as zero. Such a fabricated bundle still receives PASS_PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE_UNHAMMERED because counts are not cross-bound to an address-timed simulator receipt.

minimum_additive_successor: Separate SOURCE_FIXTURE from production code paths. PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE must require exact allowlisted sealed authorities for checkpoint, config, profile, canonical capture, fresh capture-result hammer, every charge producer, and energy producer; bind review SHA, manifest SHA, outer-file SHA, producer source/interpreter/tool identity, and admitted status. Opaque read-only files plus self-declared SHA are insufficient.
Require fixed_numerator equality for every population key across all six rows before weighting, then independently recheck aggregate equality.

Split common and direct energy. Common work must use one row-invariant admitted energy authority; row-specific rates may apply only to explicitly row-dependent hardware blocks and must be pinned to native PTPX/macro authorities.
Require an exact sealed population manifest containing the three admitted sequence IDs, sample IDs, density strata, and pre-result aggregation weights; reject any config-local substitution.
Reject a symlink at every path component from workspace root to leaf, and apply equivalent immutability checks to the config and output parent.
Cross-bind SRAM/DRAM counts to sealed address-timed replay receipts and require total/categorical conservation. Do not infer accounting from field presence or macro-name coverage.
Emit the full input authority identities and config digest in the output. Keep production output non-admitted until a fresh different-author bundle hammer validates all authorities.
